output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.sales_rep_id = 3
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Counts distinct orders in marts.fct_orders assigned to sales rep 3 with order_date in calendar year 2025. No status or is_revenue filter is applied, since the question asks for orders of any status. The date range is half-open so it includes all of 2025.
